title: Skill
description: Instructions an AI assistant reads before a task it matches, authored and versioned on the wiki

description*.de: Anleitung, die ein KI-Assistent vor einer passenden Aufgabe liest, hier im Wiki gepflegt
description*.en: Instructions an AI assistant reads before a task it matches, authored and versioned on the wiki

skill_name.title: Skill name
skill_name.description: Short slug the assistant calls this skill by, e.g. 'osl-page-editing'. Lower case, hyphens, no spaces - it is an identifier, not a label.

applies_to.title: Applies to
applies_to.description: Assistants this skill is meant for. Empty means all of them.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Files the instructions refer to. Named here rather than inlined so the assistant can list them cheaply and fetch only what it needs.
